Background: tab pages now come from cross-platform page IDs (see [Tab pages from page IDs](Tab-Page-Registry.md)), but the plus button can still only be registered in code (`+registerPlusButton`): a configuration cannot describe it, and a remote configuration cannot hide or replace it. |

## 现状 / How it works today

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 1. App 写一个 `CYLPlusButton` 子类，遵守 `CYLPlusButtonSubclassing`，实现 `+plusButton`（必需），可选 `+indexOfPlusButtonInTabBar`、`+plusChildViewController`、`+shouldSelectPlusChildViewController`、`+multiplierOfTabBarHeight:`、`+constantOfPlusButtonCenterYOffsetForTabBarHeight:`、`+tabBarContext`。 | 1. The app writes a `CYLPlusButton` subclass that adopts `CYLPlusButtonSubclassing` and implements `+plusButton` (required), and optionally `+indexOfPlusButtonInTabBar`, `+plusChildViewController`, `+shouldSelectPlusChildViewController`, `+multiplierOfTabBarHeight:`, `+constantOfPlusButtonCenterYOffsetForTabBarHeight:`, `+tabBarContext`. |
| 2. 通常在 `+load` 中调用 `+registerPlusButton`：按子类的 `+tabBarContext`（默认 "CYLTabBarController"）注册。每个 context 一个 PlusButton；共用 context 的多个 TabBarController 各自得到一份实例（issue #414、#489）。 | 2. Usually in `+load`, `+registerPlusButton` registers it under the subclass's `+tabBarContext` (default "CYLTabBarController"). One plus button per context; tab bar controllers that share a context each get their own instance (issues #414, #489). |
| 3. TabBarController 按自己的 `context`（`CYLTabBarControllerContext`）找到 PlusButton。**因此配置文件现在已经可以通过 `CYLTabBarControllerContext` 选择代码中注册的 PlusButton**，这是零改动的现有能力。 | 3. A tab bar controller finds its plus button by its own `context` (`CYLTabBarControllerContext`). **So a configuration can already choose a plus button registered in code through `CYLTabBarControllerContext`**: an existing ability that needs no change. |
| 4. 位置由一条规则决定（[#774](https://github.com/ChenYilong/CYLTabBarController/pull/774)，见 [PlusButton 的 slot](PlusButton-Slot.md)）：`-setViewControllers:` 先去掉所有 slot，再插入且只插入一个；液态玻璃固定在中间（不支持自定义位置），经典样式与扁平样式使用 `+indexForTabbarItemsCount:`。配置文件生成的 TabBar 也走这条路径；复用已有 TabBarController 的数组时，其中的 slot 会先被去掉（边界情况 B26）。因此问题 5 中的 `CYLPlusButtonIndex` 在液态玻璃下不会生效。 | 4. One rule places it ([#774](https://github.com/ChenYilong/CYLTabBarController/pull/774), see [The PlusButton slot](PlusButton-Slot.md)): `-setViewControllers:` removes every slot, then inserts exactly one; Liquid Glass keeps it in the middle (no custom position), classic and FlatDesign use `+indexForTabbarItemsCount:`. Tab bars created from a configuration take the same path; a slot carried by re-used arrays of an existing tab bar controller is removed first (edge case B26). So a `CYLPlusButtonIndex` (question 5) would have no effect on Liquid Glass. |
| 现状的不足：context 同时承担其他含义，不是跨端 ID；PlusButton 必须在 `+load` 中提前注册；子类的 `+tabBarContext` 写死了它属于哪个 TabBar；远程配置无法隐藏 PlusButton，也无法指定位置或按平台 / 版本控制；PlusButton 的子页面只能来自 `+plusChildViewController`，不能使用页面注册表。 | What is missing: the context means other things too and is not a cross-platform ID; the plus button must be registered ahead of time in `+load`; the subclass's `+tabBarContext` fixes which tab bar it belongs to; a remote configuration cannot hide it, place it, or control it by platform / version; its child page can only come from `+plusChildViewController`, not from the page registry. |

## 方案 / Options

### P1：只用 context（零改动）/ P1: context only (no change)

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 文档化现有用法：配置中的 `CYLTabBarControllerContext` 即“PlusButton 的 ID”，代码中为每个 context 注册一个子类。优点：不改代码。缺点：上面列出的不足都还在。 | Document the existing use: `CYLTabBarControllerContext` in a configuration is the plus button's "ID", and code registers one subclass per context. Pros: no code change. Cons: everything listed above remains. |

### P2（推荐）：PlusButton 也按 ID 注册 / P2 (recommended): plus buttons registered by ID too

```json
{
  "CYLTabBarControllerContext": "Home",
  "CYLTabBarControllerPlusButton": {
    "CYLPlusButtonIdentifier": "publish",
    "CYLPlusButtonPageIdentifier": "compose",
    "CYLPlusButtonIndex": 2,
    "CYLTabBarItemPlatforms": "ios,android",
    "CYLTabBarItemMinimumAppVersion": "2.0.0"
  },
  "CYLTabBarControllerTabBarItemsAttributes": [ ... ]
}
```

```objc
// 注册一次（全局或某个 TabBar 自己的注册表）/ register once (shared, or a tab bar's own registry)
[CYLTabBarPageRegistry.sharedRegistry registerPlusButtonClass:[PublishPlusButton class] forPlusButtonIdentifier:@"publish"];

// 或自动注册：子类实现 +cylPlusButtonIdentifier（类似 CYLTabBarPage）/ or automatic: the subclass implements +cylPlusButtonIdentifier
@implementation PublishPlusButton
+ (NSString *)cylPlusButtonIdentifier { return @"publish"; }
+ (id)plusButton { ... }
@end
```

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 规则：配置有 `CYLTabBarControllerPlusButton` 时，库按 `CYLPlusButtonIdentifier` 依次在本 TabBar 的注册表、全局注册表、自动注册的子类中找到 PlusButton 子类，并**为这个 TabBarController 的 context 注册它**（新的内部方法，不再依赖子类的 `+tabBarContext` 与 `+load`）。没有这个键时行为与现在完全相同（按 context 查找代码注册的 PlusButton）。 | Rules: when a configuration has `CYLTabBarControllerPlusButton`, the library finds the plus button subclass by `CYLPlusButtonIdentifier` in this tab bar's registry, the shared registry, then the automatically registered subclasses, and **registers it for this tab bar controller's context** (a new internal method that no longer relies on the subclass's `+tabBarContext` or `+load`). Without that key, nothing changes (the plus button registered in code for the context is used). |
| `CYLPlusButtonPageIdentifier`（可选）：PlusButton 的子页面由页面注册表按页面 ID 创建，覆盖 `+plusChildViewController`；未设置时沿用子类的实现。`CYLPlusButtonIndex`（可选）：覆盖 `+indexOfPlusButtonInTabBar`。平台 / 最低版本不满足时，本 TabBarController 不显示 PlusButton（即使该 context 在代码中注册了一个）。值为 `null` 或 `{}`：明确不显示 PlusButton。 | `CYLPlusButtonPageIdentifier` (optional): the plus button's child page is created by the page registry from that page ID, overriding `+plusChildViewController`; missing: the subclass's own. `CYLPlusButtonIndex` (optional): overrides `+indexOfPlusButtonInTabBar`. When the platform / minimum version does not match, this tab bar controller shows no plus button (even if code registered one for its context). A value of `null` or `{}`: explicitly no plus button. |
| 多个 TabBar：每个 TabBar 有自己的 context，各自的注册表可以把同一个 PlusButton ID 对应到不同子类。Android：同样的 ID 对应一个中间按钮工厂（演示中加入中间按钮）。 | Several tab bars: each has its own context, and their registries can map one plus button ID to different subclasses. Android: the same ID maps to a center-button factory (the demo gets a center button). |
| 优点：跨端 ID、远程可隐藏 / 替换 / 定位，复用页面注册表与查找顺序，不改变现有代码路径。缺点：需要在 `CYLPlusButton.m` 的按 context 注册机制上加一个“按 context 注册指定类”的内部入口，以及每个 TabBarController 的“隐藏”标记；液态玻璃与 FlatDesign 下需要重新验证。 | Pros: a cross-platform ID; a remote configuration can hide, replace and place it; reuses the page registry and its lookup order; existing code paths unchanged. Cons: `CYLPlusButton.m`'s per-context registration needs an internal "register this class for this context" entry and a per-controller "hidden" flag; Liquid Glass and FlatDesign need to be checked again. |

### P3：在配置中完整描述 PlusButton / P3: describe the whole plus button in the configuration

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 配置写出图片、标题、尺寸、偏移（`CYLPlusButtonImage`、`CYLPlusButtonTitle`、`CYLPlusButtonSize`、`CYLPlusButtonCenterYOffset`……），库内置一个通用 PlusButton 子类按配置生成，不需要 App 写子类。优点：纯配置即可增加 / 修改 PlusButton（如节日活动按钮）。缺点：需要新的通用子类与大量键，自定义绘制、动画、点击行为仍需代码；可以在 P2 之后作为扩展。 | The configuration spells out the image, title, size and offset (`CYLPlusButtonImage`, `CYLPlusButtonTitle`, `CYLPlusButtonSize`, `CYLPlusButtonCenterYOffset`...), and a generic built-in plus button subclass is made from it, with no subclass in the app. Pros: a plus button can be added or changed by configuration alone (e.g. a holiday campaign button). Cons: a new generic subclass and many keys; custom drawing, animation and taps still need code. Can come after P2 as an extension. |

## 对比 / Comparison

| 维度 Criterion | P1 | P2 | P3 |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| 改动 Code change | 无 / none | 中 / medium | 大 / large |
| 跨端 ID Cross-platform ID | ⚠️ context | ✅ | ✅ |
| 远程隐藏 / 替换 Hide / replace remotely | ⚠️ 只能切换 context / switch context only | ✅ | ✅ |
| 子页面来自页面注册表 Child page from the page registry | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ |
| 无需子类 No subclass needed | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ |
| 现有代码不受影响 Existing code unaffected | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |

## 需要你决定的问题 / Questions for you to decide

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 1. 采用哪个方案？建议 P2，P3 以后作为扩展。 | 1. Which option? Proposed: P2, with P3 later as an extension. |
| 2. 键名：顶层 `CYLTabBarControllerPlusButton`（字典）加 `CYLPlusButtonIdentifier` / `CYLPlusButtonPageIdentifier` / `CYLPlusButtonIndex`，可以吗？ | 2. Key names: a top-level `CYLTabBarControllerPlusButton` (dictionary) with `CYLPlusButtonIdentifier` / `CYLPlusButtonPageIdentifier` / `CYLPlusButtonIndex`: OK? |
| 3. PlusButton 子类注册放在同一个 `CYLTabBarPageRegistry`（推荐，一个注册表管理页面与 PlusButton），还是单独的 `CYLPlusButtonRegistry`？ | 3. Register plus button subclasses in the same `CYLTabBarPageRegistry` (proposed: one registry for pages and plus buttons), or in a separate `CYLPlusButtonRegistry`? |
| 4. 配置中写了 PlusButton 但 ID 未注册时：不显示 PlusButton 并警告（推荐），还是回退到该 context 在代码中注册的 PlusButton？ | 4. When a configuration names a plus button whose ID is not registered: show none, with a warning (proposed), or fall back to the plus button registered in code for the context? |
| 5. 是否允许配置覆盖位置（`CYLPlusButtonIndex`）与垂直偏移？ | 5. May a configuration override the position (`CYLPlusButtonIndex`) and the vertical offset? |
| 6. Android 演示是否加入中间按钮？ | 6. Should the Android demo get a center button? |
